# 74107 - Dual J-K master-slave flip-flop

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74107.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74107.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Q = FF1 | Flip-flop output. |
| 2 | /1Q = NOT FF1 | Complement output. |
| 5 | 2Q = FF2 | Flip-flop output. |
| 6 | /2Q = NOT FF2 | Complement output. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 2

Changes on: high-to-low transition at the end of a positive CLK pulse (master-slave)

- CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once, overriding clock and data
- CLR high, positive CLK pulse: J=L,K=L hold; J=H,K=L Q=1; J=L,K=H Q=0; J=H,K=H toggle
- The J-K data is loaded into the master while CLK is high and transferred to the slave and outputs on the high-to-low clock transition; J and K must be stable while CLK is high

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Clock and clear are double loads: IIL -3.2 mA, IIH 80 uA; J, K -1.6 mA, 40 uA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLR | Q' | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CLR | Q | PHL | 25 | 40 |
| CLK | Q or Q' | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CLK | Q or Q' | PHL | 25 | 40 |

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| pulse width | CLR low |  | 25 |  |  |
| setup | J, K | CLK rising | 0 |  |  |
| hold | J, K | CLK rising | 0 |  |  |

## Notes

IOH is -0.4 mA in this datasheet's recommended operating conditions.
